name: Αθέρας
evidence: Sources describe Porto Atheras as a sheltered sandy family beach but none explicitly mention sunbeds/umbrellas or a beach bar.

name: Βάτσα
evidence: visitkefaloniaisland.gr: Vatsa Bay offers loungers and umbrellas plus beach bars serving drinks/light meals and water sports (kayak, ski).

name: Βραχινάρι
evidence: 1001beach describes Vrachinari (end of Vatsa Bay) as a quiet cozy sandy beach with fenced turtle nests; no mention of sunbeds or a bar.

name: Κακό Λαγκάδι
evidence: Described as a hidden/remote pebble beach between Skala and Poros reached by climbing down rocks on a path; no facilities mentioned anywhere.

name: Καμίνια
evidence: visitkefaloniaisland.gr: Kaminia (Ratzakli) has sunbeds and umbrellas (offered by the beach restaurant), while much of the 1.5 km beach stays free/unorganized.

name: Καραβόμυλος
evidence: Search summaries vaguely claim 'sunbeds and umbrellas provided' but no specific source page for this small pebble beach at Sami confirms it; guide page 404s.

name: Κορώνι
evidence: visitkefaloniaisland.gr: 'Koroni is organized, with sunbeds and umbrellas, and a small canteen offering essentials' (Kefalonia's Koroni near Thiramonas/Lourdata).

name: Κουνόπετρα
evidence: Basic amenities on the beach: 'λίγες ξαπλώστρες και ομπρέλες', with tavernas/cafes a short distance away (feelgreece/terrabook).

name: Παραλία Αγία Βαρβάρα
evidence: Conflicting sources for Agia Varvara (Katelios): one says sunbeds, umbrellas and playground; another says no beach bar or sunbeds to protect the turtle-nesting environment.

name: Σπαρτιάς
evidence: Terrabook: 'Η παραλία Σπαρτιά είναι ανοργάνωτη' — village shops/tavernas nearby but no sunbeds on the beach.

name: Τραπεζάκι
evidence: Multiple sources: 'δημοφιλής και οργανωμένη παραλία' with sunbeds and umbrellas for rent, tavernas/cafes in the wider area.

name: Φωκι
evidence: Foki (Fiscardo) 'does not have loungers, so you need to be organized to visit it' — bring your own supplies.

name: Δεσίμι
evidence: Lefkada sources: Desimi is 'organized in a small part' with loungers, umbrellas and water sports; taverna and two campsites at its edges (other parts free/quiet).

name: Παραλία Νικιάνας
evidence: A section of Nikiana beach is organized with sunbeds and umbrellas (rest free for towels), tavernas/cafes in the village.

name: Νότια Παραλία Νικιάνας
evidence: Sources cover Nikiana's main beach (partly organized) but nothing specifically distinguishes the southern stretch.

name: Αμμούσα
evidence: Ammoussa is 'half-organized with loungers and umbrellas' rented from the taverna(s) by the beach, half free.

name: Αμμόγλωσσα
evidence: Lefkada Slow Guide: 'η παραλία δεν είναι οργανωμένη' with virtually no natural shade — bring umbrella and supplies (loungers exist only on adjacent Kastro beach).

name: Λυγιά
evidence: 'You will find umbrellas and sun loungers at Lygia Beach' (relaxed, lightly organized); SEATRAC installed; fish tavernas next to the beach.

name: Άι Γιάννης (Λευκάδα)
evidence: Ai Giannis is organized with umbrellas, loungers and beach bars (e.g. Anemos beach bar with loungers and surfer board storage).

name: Αμπελάκια
evidence: No specific source found for Ampelakia on Meganisi (name collides with Peloponnese beaches); island guides say only Fanari beach is fully organized on Meganisi.

name: Αθερινός
evidence: Meganisi guide: only Fanari beach is organized with a beach bar; Atherinos is a yacht-anchorage bay, notable as the only beach with showers — no sunbeds/bar claimed.

name: Άγιος Ιωάννης
evidence: Agrios Beach Bar, 'the most organized beach bar of Meganisi', operates on Spartochori's central beach (Agios Ioannis) with regular/special loungers, poufs and beds.

name: Αμπούλα
evidence: Ampoula (Tragaki/Tsilivi side) is a very small Blue Flag beach 'partly serviced with umbrellas and sunbeds' placed on the strip just behind the beach.

name: Δάφνη
evidence: Dafni (Marine Park turtle-nesting beach): own umbrellas are forbidden, but the beach tavernas (Petalida etc.) offer sunbeds and umbrellas, some free with consumption.

name: Καλαμάκι
evidence: Kalamaki beach has umbrellas and sunbeds (limited to a few spots due to Marine Park turtle-nesting rules); showers/changing rooms per some guides.

name: Κορακονήσι
evidence: Korakonisi is a natural rock-arch monument/swimming spot reached on foot by a rocky path — no umbrellas, sunbeds or facilities; bring everything.

name: Μικρή Ξύγκια
evidence: ecozante on Xigia 'dipla' (the small adjacent cove): 'usually few umbrellas and loungers, so if you want shade it's better to bring your own' — sparse/seasonal, main Xigia has the canteen.

name: Μαδράκια
evidence: No source clearly describing Madrakia beach on Zakynthos was found (searches returned Marathias and unrelated beaches).

name: Πόρτο Ρόξα
evidence: Porto Roxa has seasonal tavernas/bars (Fondo Beach Bar, Ionion Taverna) offering sunbeds and parasols on wooden platforms on the rocks, free with consumption.

name: Βουρδέρη
evidence: Vourderi (Vasilikos) pages found describe location/history only; no explicit mention of sunbeds, umbrellas or a beach bar.

name: Μαυράτζης
evidence: zantehotels: Mavratzi (Vasilikos) is 'a calm and well-organized beach with umbrellas and loungers', with water sports; popular with families.

name: Παραλία Καμίνια
evidence: Ithaca sources: Kaminia (Perachori) 'is not organized and has no natural shade'; unpaved-road access, bring water and provisions.

name: Παραλία Σαρακήνικο
evidence: Ithaca municipality/guides: Sarakiniko has 'a few loungers and umbrellas as well as a canteen that offers essentials'.

name: Παραλία Δεξά
evidence: Official ithaca.gr lists Dexa as 'Pebbles, canteen' only — a canteen but no mention of sunbeds/umbrellas or a bar; natural shade from olive trees.

name: Λούτσα
evidence: Loutsa (Vathy) 'διαθέτει κάποια οργάνωση, με λίγες ξαπλώστρες και ομπρέλες προς ενοικίαση' plus a canteen; Blue Flag.

name: Πόλη
evidence: Polis beach (Stavros): canteen with snacks, water fountain, showers, umbrellas and loungers, parking and boat rental.

name: Παραλία Μάρμακα
evidence: Marmakas (next to Frikes) 'is not organized, however there is a canteen for essentials' in summer; shade from eucalyptus trees.

name: Παραλία Φιλιατρό (Κιόνι)
evidence: Filiatro is an organized beach with umbrellas/sunbeds for rent covering half its length and a beach bar for coffee, water and fast food.
